correctness.rationale: At each time the log field is an affine quadratic in sensor coordinates. Full column rank recovers w_1,w_2,z,Q and then diffusivity and emission time explicitly; true physical data ensure admissible signs. Rank-deficient null polynomial forces all sensors onto a sphere or affine hyperplane, with exact source reflection in hyperplane or Kelvin-style source/diffusivity/mass inversion for a sphere giving identical full time traces. A single snapshot identifies only kappa*(t1-t0). Independently obtained determinant magnitude 8 of four-sensor planar example and its exact circle inversion.

final_claim: For noiseless two-time measurements of a single free-space Gaussian diffusion puff with unknown source, mass, diffusivity and emission time, global identifiability for every admissible parameter tuple holds exactly when the N-by-(d+2) lifted sensor matrix [1,s_i,||s_i||^2] has full rank. Every deficient design admits an all-time nonunique pair; d+2 sensors and two instants are sharp.
